newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Rizal Bank approves real estate deal.
newsitem.headline: Rizal Bank approves real estate deal.

text.p: Rizal Commercial Bank Corp said on Friday its board had approved a joint venture agreement with a subsidiary of the Government of Singapore Investment Corp Pte Ltd (GIC) and a local real estate company.
The bank told the Philippine Stock Exchange the joint venture will own and develop a prime real estate lot in Manila's Makati business district into an office condominium building.
Reco Rizal Pine Pte Ltd, the subsidiary of GIC, and local firm PMMIC Realty Corp will each own 15 percent of the joint venture company. -- Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
